description: Mansão VR, nestledin the prestigious Jardim Amália, offers an exquisite blend of timeless elegance and contemporary luxury across its expansive 400 m² footprint. title: Casa do Matheus
description: Nestled in the tranquil enclaveof Cajueiro, Casa do Matheus offers a meticulously curated 40m² sanctuary where thoughtful design meets Bahian charm. Every detail—from the natural material finishes to the seamless indoor-outdoor flow—evokes refined simplicity, transforming compact space into an intimate haven of light, craftsmanship, and serene sophistication. Ideal for the discerning seeker of a purposeful pied-à-terre steeped in local authenticity. (2 sentences)
